integrity: One uniform homotopy theorem, based on a self-contained topological and combinatorial proof; all computations are reproducible from verify.py, with independent external audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to total three-cut complexes of \(M_{2n}\) for integers \(n\ge5\) only; no equivariant refinement or smaller-parameter claim. Numerical checks are finite and do not prove the infinite family.
title: Uniform sphere-wedge homotopy for Möbius-ladder total three-cut complexes
